svg.title: CortexAgent — Multi-Agent Rag
svg.desc: Four LangGraph agents answer SEC 10-K research questions, cite filing chunks and pass every draft through a critic before it is returned. Evidence: 20/20 prompts passed in the documented single-model behavioral-contract baseline, not the full orchestrator.
